title: RFI - CJIS Decentralized Info Sharing
agency: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF.FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION.FBI-JEH
description_text: The Criminal Justice Information Services Division (CJIS) Enterprise Architecture (EA) team is looking to identify capabilities that can facilitate and/or enable a national decentralized information sharing environment that will allow states to analyze and share information from Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Law Enforcement Records Management Systems (LERMS), and other criminal justice/public safety information systems without requiring data to be uploaded into a centralized national-level information system.
